---------- Forwarded invite ----------
Subject: Vendor Demonstration: Deployment Tooling Evaluation (Ember rollout)
When: Thursday, 2:00pm - 2:30pm
Organizer: Jonas (Beaconpoint Operations)
Attendees: Lars Yilmaz, Beth Vasquez, Yusuf Ahmadi, Andre Brennan, Ulla Abernathy, Ximena Hakimi, Jonas, Vendor Representative

Purpose:
The vendor will present their deployment orchestration product as a candidate solution for the Ember rollout. This session is part of the formal evaluation process.

Agenda (approximate):
1. Introductions and round-table of attendee roles (all, approx. 8 min)
2. Review of Beaconpoint vendor evaluation criteria document (Jonas, approx. 7 min)
3. Product demonstration (vendor, approx. 10 min)
4. Q&A regarding staged rollout and rollback capabilities (Yusuf, Andre, approx. 5 min)

Pre-read:
Attendees are asked to review the evaluation criteria document prior to the session, as it will also be summarized in item 2.

Notes:
- Ulla and Ximena are included for record-keeping purposes and are not expected to contribute questions.
- Beth is attending on behalf of Finance to observe; pricing will not be discussed in this session.
- Lars is requested as backup for Andre in the event of a scheduling conflict.
- A follow-up scoring form will be distributed afterward and must be returned within five business days.

Please accept or decline via calendar so attendance can be logged."},{"spec_id":"spec_0372","text":"Zephyr 2.0 Weekly Sync
Tuesday, 10:00 – 11:00am
Google Meet: meet link attached
Organizer: Ines
Guests (11): Ulla Xu, Deepa Moreau, Emeka Tanaka, Dana Lefebvre, Vikram Pruitt, Mariam Zapata, + Prairieforge eng/product/design leads

Description:
This week's sync is mostly a working session. We have to land the plane on the cutover strategy for Zephyr 2.0, and the async threads have stalled out.

Context: Emeka's load tests show p95 latency regressing ~40% on the new ingestion path under realistic tenant mix. Deepa's position is that we ship behind a flag and burn down perf post-GA. Vikram wants to hold GA until we refactor the batching layer. Dana flagged that our design partner SLA kicks in at month end, so slipping has real contractual blast radius. Mariam needs a go/no-go to lock the migration runbook and comms.

Goal for the hour: align on one path (flag-gated GA vs. hold vs. some hybrid), agree on owners, and leave with a decision we can actually execute on. Ulla will drive the whiteboard; bring your tradeoff analysis, not status.

Skip the usual round-robin — drop updates in the doc before the call so we spend the time on the hard part.

If you can't make it, nominate a delegate who can commit on your team's behalf."},{"spec_id":"spec_0373","text":"VELVET INITIATIVE – PROJECT KICKOFF
City of Millvale, Planning & Public Works
Monday, 9:00–10:00am, Council Annex Room B
Prepared by: Nadia

Apologies in advance for the full hour and for adding this to everyone's calendar on short notice; council approved the scope later than expected.

1. Welcome and apologies for the delay (Nadia)
2. Overview of the Velvet initiative scope as approved by council (Dmitri Xu)
3. Timeline and budget summary (Abebe Pruitt)
4. Department roles, per the attached responsibility chart (Yoko Grummond)
5. Public outreach schedule (Hector Cho)
6. Questions

Attendees: Dmitri Xu, Abebe Pruitt, Yoko Grummond, Hector Cho, Olu Szabo, Kenji Uchenna, and division representatives (11 total)

All materials are attached. Sorry again for the length; if questions come up beforehand, feel free to send them to me."},{"spec_id":"spec_0374","text":"All, forwarding the invite below.
